subject: type-definition
source_phrase: If the type definition contains or inherits (7.5.7.2) a deferred type-bound procedure (7.5.5), ABSTRACT shall appear.

subject: allocate-object
source_phrase: If any allocate-object has a deferred type parameter, is unlimited polymorphic, or is of abstract type, either type-spec or source-expr shall appear.

subject: data-pointer-object
source_phrase: If data-target is unlimited polymorphic, data-pointer-object shall be unlimited polymorphic, or of a type with the BIND attribute or the SEQUENCE attribute.
reason: joined continuation and referenced type alternatives

subject: derived-type-spec
source_phrase: The type-spec or derived-type-spec shall not specify a derived type with the BIND attribute or the SEQUENCE attribute.

subject: implicit-typed-reference
source_phrase: If a dummy-arg-name, variable, function reference, or dummy function reference is typed by the implicit typing rules, its appearance in any subsequent type declaration statement shall confirm this implied type and the values of any implied type parameters.
reason: implicit type and parameter agreement require a richer fact vocabulary

subject: entry-name
source_phrase: If RESULT appears, the entry-name shall not appear in any specification or type declaration statement in the scoping unit of the function subprogram.
